request: Inspect actual DebugAI production repository and pre-existing protected admission files metadata only; no mutation or AI work

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'SERVERCORE_HEAD=';git -C /home/admin1/server-core rev-parse HEAD
printf 'DEBUGAI_HEAD=';git -C /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai rev-parse HEAD
printf 'DEBUGAI_PARENT_DIRTY=';git -C /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | wc -l
printf 'SCRIPT_HEAD_VS_PR=';git -C /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai rev-parse HEAD:scripts/host-gitops-master-internal.sh
printf 'SCRIPT_ON_DISK_SHA256=';sha256sum /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai/scripts/host-gitops-master-internal.sh | cut -d' ' -f1
printf 'MASTER_REGISTRY_HOST_SHA256=';sha256sum /home/admin1/server-core/operations/master-internal-repositories.json | cut -d' ' -f1
printf 'TRUST_INSTALL_ACCESS='; if test -r /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai/scripts/host-gitops-register-master.sh; then echo READABLE;else echo RESTRICTED;fi
printf 'INSTALL_POLICY_READ_ACCESS='; if test -r /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai/.gitops/delegation/policies/dlg_master_debugai_v1.json; then echo READABLE;else echo RESTRICTED_OR_OTHER_PATH;fi
printf 'TRUSTED_REGISTRY_COMMAND='; if test -x /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai/scripts/host-gitops-register-master.sh;then echo AVAILABLE;else echo NOT_EXECUTABLE;fi
printf 'COMPOSE_DEFINITION_SHA256=';sha256sum /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai/compose.yaml | cut -d' ' -f1
